🚀 Field Support / IT Infrastructure Engineer | Romania | On-site 
 At CrewHarbor, we connect skilled IT professionals with international companies and projects.
 We are currently looking for a Field Support / IT Infrastructure Engineer to support an international client with day-to-day IT operations, infrastructure support, and migration activities in Romania.
 📍This is a primarily on-site role, and travel to different client locations across Romania may be required .
 Your Responsibilities 
Provide technical support for workstations, laptops, peripherals, and handheld scanners.
Install, configure, and troubleshoot IT hardware.
Assist the 2nd Level Network Team with on-site technical activities.
Install, deploy, and replace network equipment.
Support local network and IT infrastructure tasks.
Assist with workstation migrations to the client's IT environment.
Support the migration of legacy services to new infrastructure.
Contribute to local IT support, infrastructure, and migration projects.
 What We're Looking For 
Previous experience in Field Support, IT Support, or IT Infrastructure Support.
Good knowledge of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft environments.
Hands-on experience with hardware installation and troubleshooting.
Basic understanding of networking and IT infrastructure.
Willingness to work on-site and travel to different locations within Romania when needed.
Good communication and problem-solving skills.
 Project Details 
 Work setup: Primarily on-site, with potential travel across Romania
 Start: As soon as possible
 Duration: 222 project days
 🚀 Interested?
 If you have experience in IT support and enjoy hands-on technical work, we'd be happy to hear from you.
